assets.alt_text: Brood comb showing malpositioned and discoloured honey bee larvae with symptoms compatible with European foulbrood
assets.caption: EFB larvae. Malpositioned and discoloured larvae are important field signs that can raise suspicion of European foulbrood, but visual appearance can overlap with other brood abnormalities; confirm according to current local diagnostic and regulatory guidance.
assets.credit: Photo by Eva Forsgren. Source: Budge et al., Standard methods for European foulbrood research 2.0, Journal of Apicultural Research, CC BY 4.0.
